decisions.reason: It is close to the firm's established candle-arch craft base and its home-page visibility in 2018 and 2019 suggests demand the firm can understand and refine with existing know-how.
As a direct extension of the firm's core Christmas pyramid competence and a prominently featured product in both observed years, it fits the firm's knowledge base very well.

Although it was prominently marketed, the electronic and interchangeable-disc concept is distant from the firm's traditional woodworking capabilities, and with no visible R&D base it is harder for management to learn from and improve.
The second edition indicates some market learning, but as an accessory for an electronic product outside the firm's main knowledge domain it remains relatively vulnerable to discontinuation.

This seasonal electronic music-box variant is technologically distant from the firm's craft tradition and likely to lose out when resources are shifted back toward products the firm understands better.
It builds directly on the firm's established Christmas-pyramid and regional-theme strengths and was kept highly visible, so management would likely continue it.
